company.name: Okteto
company.shortDescription: Okteto specializes in the fields of software development, software engineering, and the cloud computing industry.
company.description:
Okteto is a computer software company that specializes in the fields of software development, software engineering, and the cloud computing industry. The company allows to Iinstantly spin up pre-configured environments in the cloud and start developing within seconds.

Okteto was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that automates the creation of Kubernetes-based development environments, enabling developers to code in production-like settings with instant feedback and minimal setup time.
productsAndServices.name: Okteto Development Environments

productsAndServices.description: Automated environments that deploy code changes for every pull request, enabling teams to test and collaborate on live, production-like instances before merging.
productsAndServices.name: Okteto Preview Environments

productsAndServices.description: A self-hosted solution that runs on an organization's Kubernetes infrastructure, providing scalable, secure, and policy-driven development environments with advanced access control and resource management.
productsAndServices.name: Okteto Enterprise

productsAndServices.description: A command-line interface tool that enables developers to create and manage cloud-native development environments on Kubernetes clusters from their local machines.
productsAndServices.name: Okteto CLI

productsAndServices.description: A testing service that integrates with existing testing frameworks to run tests directly in Kubernetes development environments, ensuring consistency between development and production.
productsAndServices.name: Okteto Test

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $15,000,000, or 82.96% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,070,824 to $85,922,278, a 27.98x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 62 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 69 (+1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
